title: When Uzziah dies, Isaiah sees the Lord
english: First vision: [[In the year King Uzziah died I saw the Lord seated on a high throne >> Bible:Isaiah 6:1]]. As long as Uzziah lived Isaiah could not see — Uzziah the sinner who entered the temple and was [[struck with leprosy on the forehead >> Bible:2 Chronicles 26:16-21]]. Such a prince of the soul must die if we are to see God’s vision. If Uzziah lives we do not see God’s glory; when he dies we see. [[Let not sin reign in your mortal body >> Bible:Romans 6:12]] — those [[loving pleasure rather than God >> Bible:2 Timothy 3:4]].

title: High throne and the house full of glory
english: [[I saw the Lord seated on a throne high and lifted up >> Bible:Isaiah 6:1]]. Not everyone who sees the Lord sees him on a high throne — Daniel saw [[thrones set >> Bible:Daniel 7:9]]; in Jehoshaphat’s valley he sits to judge. God is seen above or below according to the matter’s worth. [[The house was full of his glory >> Bible:Isaiah 6:1]] — not this earthly fullness of God’s glory.

title: Seraphim cry Holy Holy Holy
english: [[Seraphim stood about him, six wings to each >> Bible:Isaiah 6:2]]. With two they veiled God’s face, with two his feet, with two they flew. They cried [[Holy, Holy, Holy >> Bible:Isaiah 6:3]] — Trinity’s mystery. Origen reads the two Seraphim as the Lord Jesus and the Holy Spirit. They cover the face — God’s beginning unknown; the feet — the last things incomprehensible; only the middle is seen. Glory to the Trinity. Amen.
